jobs.title: Lansing, MI - IT - CSS - End User Support - MiECC - Business Analyst 5
jobs.description:
We are seeking a Senior CRM Business Analyst to support the development, onboarding, tracking, and continuous improvement of strategic public health workflows mapped into a Salesforce CRM ecosystem for a project based in Lansing, MI.


Location: Lansing, MI 48933 (Candidates must be located within 90 miles of Lansing at the time of submission)


Work Arrangement: Hybrid


Role Type: 14-Month Contract (With long-term potential)


Interview: Virtual


Key Responsibilities


Requirements & Process Reengineering: Review, analyze, and map complex business workflows. Author detailed functional and technical specifications to optimize Salesforce configurations.


Queue Triage & Communications: Actively manage and prioritize the primary CRM inbox communications and user ticketing loops, assigning priority and severity metrics.


Data & BI Architecture: Partner with development teams to gather enterprise reporting datasets, formulate cost/benefit matrices, and support downstream data warehouse upgrades.


Training & Support: Design, publish, and present comprehensive training assets, detailed job aids, step-by-step documentation, and web-based instructional webinars for end-users.


Quality Assurance: Collaborate with core QA/Testing teams during peak release cycles to validate features against defined requirements before deployment.


Required Skills & Experience


Business Analysis: 5+ years of progressive professional experience acting as a dedicated IT Business Analyst.


Salesforce Platform: Proven experience as a Business Analyst specifically working with applications and custom modules built directly on the Salesforce CRM platform.


Testing Background: Demonstrable experience assisting with Quality Assurance (QA / Testing) execution, script writing, and system validation.


Desired Skills


Direct experience operating within Local, State, or Federal government agency workflows.


Familiarity navigating work item tracking systems inside Azure DevOps.


Working knowledge of regulatory compliance rules and frameworks, including HIPAA and FedRAMP.


Experience with enterprise contact center infrastructure suites (such as Nice CXone).


Strong understanding of relational database concepts and proficiency across the Microsoft Office suite.

Work Location: 55 Farmington Ave. Hartford, CT
Mode of Interview: Teams Meeting (Video)

Python Development: 3+ years of experience writing clean application logic and building Web APIs within modern frameworks (like FastAPI).
LLM Integration: 2+ years of experience building production applications powered by Large Language Models (Gemini, Claude, GPT).

jobs.title: MI IT Agency Services DHHS Programmer Analyst 6 - IBM Master Data Management & Integration Developer
jobs.description:
We are seeking a senior-level professional to provide 100% production support and maintenance for enterprise-scale Master Data Management (MDM) platforms and downstream application integrations. The ideal candidate will operate independently to secure data integrity, resolve incidents, and manage application uptime.

Location: 320 S Walnut St, Lansing, MI, 48933
Work Arrangement: Hybrid (Mondays and Tuesdays are strictly required on-site from day one; non-negotiable)
Interview Process: Virtual, single-round panel interview (mostly technical evaluation with a brief soft-skills assessment)

Highlighted Technical Core Skills
Required Capabilities (Non-Negotiable):

8+ Years of enterprise software development experience.
IBM InfoSphere MDM v14.x Standard Edition (Virtual MDM) — Deep knowledge of data models, entities, transactions, batch processing, and troubleshooting.
Apache Kafka — Multi-year event-streaming experience including topic creation, configuration, message flow debugging, and Zookeeper/KRaft concepts via Strimzi operator.

Highly Desired Skills:

Java/J2EE Stack: 8+ years with Java, JSP, and REST/SOAP-based services alongside production logging diagnosis.
OS & Automation: 5+ years with Linux/Unix systems (command-line, log analysis, Bash/Shell scripting, and CRON jobs) plus Windows PowerShell.
Middleware: Hands-on experience with WildFly application servers (deployments, health checks, and integrating WildFly with Kafka/MDM).
Databases: Strong proficiency writing and optimizing SQL queries within Oracle and Microsoft SQL Server environments.
DevOps & Infrastructure: Experience deploying to Cloud/Containerized environments (AWS, Azure, OpenShift, Kubernetes) and working with Azure DevOps CI/CD pipelines.
Monitoring & Security: Log aggregation using the ELK/Elastic Stack and managing/deploying SSL/TLS Certificates across Windows/Linux.
Bonus: Hands-on experience with the Flowable workflow engine.

Key Responsibilities

Provide application support and track defects/incidents across critical production and non-production systems.
Collaborate with Infrastructure teams (Linux, Windows, Network) to resolve runtime environment issues and execute Requests for Change (RFC).
Coordinate with DBAs to implement database enhancements and pull system metrics.
Execute the full SDLC loop by gathering functional requirements, generating technical specifications, and overseeing UAT/Post-Implementation testing.

jobs.title: GA DDS IT Support Specialist 3

jobs.description:

Work Arrangement: 100% Onsite
Location: Conyers, GA (Must be local to Metro Atlanta)
Interview Mode: In-Person Only

Key Technical Skills Required
To be considered for this position, candidates must possess strong experience in the following areas:
1. Cloud & Automation

AWS & Terraform: Minimum 2 years of hands-on experience using AWS CLI and Terraform for automation and environment provisioning.
Cloud Infrastructure: Ability to maintain, design, and optimize scalable, cost-efficient internal cloud applications.

2. Systems & Networking

Active Directory: 2+ years managing Active Directory, including DNS, DHCP, and Local/Group Policies.
Network Troubleshooting: 3+ years resolving TCP/IP and basic network connectivity issues.
Hardware & OS: 2+ years installing, maintaining, and troubleshooting desktop hardware, Windows 10/11, Chrome boxes, and peripherals (scanners, network printers).

3. Operations & Support

ServiceNow: 2+ years managing, triaging, and escalating tickets within ServiceNow.
Peripherals & Specialized Equipment: Ability to learn and support specialized operational equipment (lobby management software, A/V systems, video conferencing, camera equipment).

Minimum Qualifications & Requirements

Mandate: Professional certification is REQUIRED (e.g., CompTIA A+, Network+, Cloud+, or equivalent). You must be able to provide a copy of your certification upon submission.
Education & Experience: * Bachelor’s degree in IT/Computer Science + 3 years of related IT support experience OR

Associate/Vocational degree + 5 years of related IT support experience.



Competencies for Success

Excellent communication and customer service skills to support end-users effectively.
Strong incident triage, problem-solving skills, and a desire to continuously learn emerging IT technologies.
Proven ability to minimize system downtime and data leakage.
